kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Band Rs 163-172, lot 87 (company announcement as reported; RHP prints [●]). At Rs 172: 2.8617 crore post-offer shares, market cap Rs 492 cr; P/E 22.6x FY26 PAT to owners (27.1x on adjusted Rs 18.18 cr); company's own P/E 16.6x (pre-offer weighted shares); P/B 2.25x post-offer; EV/EBITDA 14.4x FY26.

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: CFO Rs 2.03 / 18.39 / 3.30 cr FY24-26 against PAT Rs 4.81 / 20.03 / 22.33 cr: cumulative CFO 50% of PAT. FY26 CFO was held down by an inventory build of Rs 20.34 cr for the new tube and 2/3-wheeler tyre plants and Rs 6.52 cr of other financial assets (including related-party loans). Q1 FY27 CFO Rs 6.25 cr against PAT Rs 6.42 cr.

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: Loans and advances to promoters and promoter entities outstanding Rs 13.13 cr at Jun-26 (Mohit Gupta Rs 5.81 cr, Manju Gupta Rs 1.94 cr, Moonriver Interiors LLP Rs 2.63 cr, Qualimax Electronics Rs 1.11 cr and others), given without repayment terms and interest-free except to the two promoters (p. 82); FY26 gross loans to Moonriver Interiors Rs 9.73 cr and to Mohit Gupta Rs 7.52 cr. Disclosed in full; no issue proceeds go to promoters (p. 115). No related-party capex.

focus.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
focus.detail: JK Tyre & Industries 36.25% / 41.19% / 59.56% of revenue FY24-26 and 88.67% in Q1 FY27; the second customer fell from 48.69% (FY25) and 25.15% (FY26) to 5.63% in Q1 FY27; top 10 customers 96-99%. Top supplier 31.74% of FY26 purchases; top 10 suppliers 73.69%. A long-term agreement exists only with JK Tyre (p. 23).

focus.title: CARO / audit trail
focus.detail: The accounting software used in FY26 did not have an audit-trail (edit log) feature; party balances are subject to confirmation (p. 352). Delays of up to 90-100 days in GST annual returns and up to 91 days in EPF compliances (p. 35).

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -69.5% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: RED: objects floor sits above blended fair value

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Names of customers other than JK Tyre (consent not given)

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Contract terms with JK Tyre (tenor, pricing formula, exclusivity)

comfort.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
comfort.detail: Two bonus issues before filing: 2:1 on 28-Jul-2025 and 1:1 on 8-May-2026 (pp. 93-94); EPS restated post-bonus for all periods. FY26 basic EPS Rs 10.36 on PAT to owners Rs 21.82 cr = 2.106 crore weighted shares; pre-offer capital is 2.2855 crore shares (p. 92), on which FY26 EPS is Rs 9.55. Private placement of 11,38,898 shares at Rs 180 in Jan-2026 = Rs 90 after the 1:1 bonus.

comfort.title: Current vs deferred tax
comfort.detail: Current tax Rs 1.84 / 6.06 / 6.61 cr = 29% / 21% / 21% of PBT; deferred tax rises because tax depreciation (Rs 8.68 cr FY26) far exceeds book depreciation (Rs 0.45 cr) (p. 332). Tax paid Rs 1.30 / 3.86 / 5.87 cr (p. 71).

comfort.title: Objects arithmetic as price floor
comfort.detail: Fresh issue is a fixed 57,61,831 shares; specific objects Rs 72.49 cr (debt Rs 45.00 cr, rubber recycling plant Rs 19.06 cr, solid tyre plant Rs 8.44 cr). Grossed up for assumed 8% expenses and GCP the objects need about Rs 172 a share: the cap funds the objects with GCP at about 19% of the fresh issue (cap 25%).

comfort.title: Revaluation reserve
comfort.detail: No revaluation of property, plant and equipment in any year.

comfort.title: Goodwill vs tangible equity
comfort.detail: Goodwill Rs 6.47 cr from the MG Industries acquisition (5.1% of equity); PPE fair-value uplift Rs 9.58 cr on acquisition (p. 313).

comfort.title: Contingent liabilities
comfort.detail: Contingent liabilities Rs 6.63 cr at Jun-26 (5.0% of equity): Jain Enterprises' Rs 4.19 cr recovery suit (Delhi High Court, in mediation) and GST/VAT demands Rs 2.44 cr. Materiality threshold Rs 0.79 cr (5% of average PAT). No criminal or regulatory action against the company or promoters.

comfort.title: Auditor qualifications / changes
comfort.detail: Statutory and peer-review auditor G B S G & Associates; no qualified opinion or disclaimer on internal financial controls for FY24-Q1 FY27 (p. 54). The FY26 change from WDV to straight-line depreciation is disclosed (p. 313) and is treated in the earnings-quality test.

comfort.title: Eligibility re-computation
comfort.detail: Reg 6(1): operating profit (PBT + finance cost - other income) Rs 8.73 / 27.80 / 34.61 cr FY24-26, average Rs 23.7 cr above the Rs 15 cr test (our computation); net worth positive each year.

strengths: Five plants in Uttarakhand, Tamil Nadu and Madhya Pradesh; flap capacity 43.2 lakh units a year (pp. 129, 134)
Long relationship and agreement with JK Tyre, a top-3 Indian tyre maker (p. 23)
Operating history since 1985 in tyre flaps (p. 194)
New tube and 2/3-wheeler tyre plants already built (p. 134)
weaknesses: JK Tyre 88.7% of Q1 FY27 revenue (p. 22)
Net debt Rs 104 cr before the issue (pp. 68-69)
Accounting software without audit trail in FY26 (p. 352)
opportunities: Filling the new 2/3-wheeler tyre plant (37% utilised) and tube plant (p. 134)
Rubber recycling and solid-tyre plants from the issue (p. 114)
Indian tyre market growing about 7% a year (p. 166)
threats: Loss or cut of JK Tyre volumes
Natural rubber and crude-linked input prices (p. 378)
Tyre makers insourcing flaps and tubes
Shift to tubeless tyres reducing flap and tube demand

adjustments.item: Depreciation cut by the switch from WDV to straight-line (excess past depreciation set off)
adjustments.reason: The holding company (FY26) and MG Industries (FY25) moved from WDV to straight-line and set the excess of past WDV depreciation against the new charge, so some asset classes bore no depreciation: FY26 depreciation fell to Rs 0.45 cr on a Rs 136.9 cr gross block, lower by Rs 2.45 cr (company) + Rs 0.85 cr (MG Industries); FY25 lower by Rs 1.28 cr. Tax depreciation was Rs 8.68 cr in FY26 (p. 332). Q1 FY27 is lower by a further Rs 1.95 cr; only Rs 0.92 cr of excess remains to absorb, so the charge rises to a normal level in FY27.

adjustments.item: Creditor balances written back to other income
adjustments.reason: Old payable balances written back to profit: Rs 1.63 cr FY25 and Rs 1.68 cr FY26 (68% of FY26 other income). Non-operating and not expected to recur.

adjustments.item: Profit on sale of property, plant and equipment
adjustments.reason: One-off gain of Rs 1.93 cr in FY25 other income.
One-off write-offs (Rs 1.39 cr FY25, Rs 0.26 cr FY26) that lowered profit; shown so the test stays two-sided, kept out of the adjusted P/E.
Mark-to-market gains on investments in other income; small. For information.

earnings_quality.verdict: Reported FY26 P/E of 22.0x is flattered by the items flagged: adjusted P/E 26.5x (PAT -16.7%). On the FY24-FY26 average, which smooths one-year items, the P/E is 31.3x reported and 37.1x adjusted.
